full_description:
UAE Hair & Beauty Business Development Freelancer – Supplier Acquisition

We are a start-up e-commerce business in the UAE focused on the Hair & Beauty sector.

Our experience in the industry comes from operating a hybrid e-commerce model in Australia for the past four years. A small number of selected top-selling brands are managed through a 3PL model, while approximately 70% of the business operates through dropship / single-order fulfilment.

Over the past five months, we have had a full-time Business Development Executive on the ground in the UAE. However, supplier identification and onboarding that aligns with our product, commercial and pricing strategy has not progressed at the level we anticipated.

We recognise that we need additional resource on the ground and are therefore exploring engaging a UAE-based freelancer under one or more of the following models.

Engagement Options

1. Fixed Hours – Business Development & Growth

A fixed number of hours per month focused on business development and supplier acquisition within the UAE Hair & Beauty industry.

We have tried this model previously, so we are not looking for a freelancer whose proposal is simply based on the number of companies contacted or meetings arranged.

If you prefer this model, you will need to present a tangible plan with measurable conversion targets, including how you would identify suitable suppliers, engage them, progress discussions and convert them into onboarded suppliers.

2. 100% Commission-Based

A performance-based model where you are compensated when you successfully identify and onboard suppliers.

The focus is therefore on results – identifying suitable suppliers, progressing the opportunity and getting the supplier onboarded, rather than simply generating leads.

Please clearly outline your expected commission structure in your proposal.

3. Ad-Hoc / As-Needed

An as-needed arrangement for specific business development requirements.

Under this model, we may work with a small pool of 2–3 freelancers, allowing us to use the person best suited to the requirement and who has capacity when a particular need arises.

Who We Are Looking For

The freelancer must be based in the UAE, ideally Dubai.

We are particularly interested in people who have:

* Existing experience in the UAE Hair & Beauty industry.
* Existing relationships with hair, beauty, cosmetics, professional beauty or related suppliers/distributors.
* Experience in supplier acquisition, business development and commercial negotiations.
* An understanding of how UAE suppliers operate and what is required to successfully onboard them.
* The ability to identify suppliers that fit a defined product and pricing strategy, rather than simply approaching any available supplier.
* A results-driven approach and the ability to convert opportunities into actual supplier relationships.

Existing industry relationships are highly desirable.

This is not a lead-generation exercise. The objective is to identify and onboard suitable suppliers.

How to Apply

If you are genuinely interested, please respond to the following four questions:

1. Location: Where are you currently based in the UAE?
2. Experience: Briefly outline your relevant Hair & Beauty industry and Business Development experience, including any relevant supplier relationships.
3. Preferred engagement: Which option do you prefer – 1) Fixed Hours, 2) Commission, or 3) As-Needed? You can select more than one.
4. Compensation: What are your compensation expectations for your preferred engagement model?

For Option 1, please also include a brief outline of your proposed approach and realistic supplier onboarding/conversion targets.

For Option 2, please include your proposed commission structure.

Please Read Before Applying

Please do not send a message simply saying “Hi”, “Can we connect?” or similar with no substance. These proposals will be ignored.

If you have a genuine question about the opportunity, please ask it.

If you are interested in the opportunity, submit your bid by responding to the four questions above. We are looking for someone who can demonstrate relevant experience, understands the UAE Hair & Beauty market and can deliver tangible results.

full_description:
Native Sell - Hyper-Local Multi-Vendor Marketplace Development in France

Job Description

I am looking for an experienced full-stack developer or small professional development team to build Native Sell, a hyper-local multi-vendor marketplace for France, starting in Toulouse.

I plan to use the eGrocer CodeCanyon source code as the starting foundation. This is not a simple theme installation or rebranding project. The existing source code needs to be properly customized to implement the Native Sell business model and requirements.

Reference Website

[login to view URL]

Please use this website as a reference for the overall marketplace UI and UX, navigation, product presentation, store presentation and shopping experience.

The final Native Sell design must be original, professionally branded and customized for the French market.

Core Requirements

The platform will include:

Customer Website and Progressive Web App (PWA)
Vendor Dashboard
Super Admin Panel
Hyper-local City and Zone Management
Location selection and zone-based marketplace
Mandatory cart locking between different cities and zones
Multiple vendors from the same city in one checkout
Master Order and Vendor Sub-orders
Stripe Connect marketplace payment system
Commission-based business model
14-day vendor settlement and payout
Centralized Admin-controlled Master Product Catalog
Vendor-specific price, stock and availability management
Vendor Product Request and Admin Approval system
Barcode and EAN-based product search
Automatic price, TVA and commission calculation
Home Delivery and Store Pickup
Future DPD, Chronopost and Mondial Relay integration
Automatic invoice generation
French e-invoicing and e-reporting ready architecture
Customer to Vendor live chat
Product and Store reviews and ratings
French, English and Bangla language support
France-focused SEO and local SEO
Bangladeshi and Asian community-focused SEO
GDPR and French legal requirements
Notifications, analytics and reporting
Complete UI and UX, branding and required launch graphics

Important Product Model

Native Sell will use a centralized Master Product Catalog.

The Admin creates and controls the master product.

Vendors will not create duplicate public product listings. They will select an existing product and manage their own:

Price
Stock
Availability
Fulfilment

If a product does not exist, the vendor can submit a Product Request. The Admin reviews and approves the request before the product becomes publicly available.

Important Order Model

A customer may purchase products from multiple vendors within the same city or zone in one checkout.

Example:

Vendor A, Vendor B and Vendor C products in one cart.
One customer checkout and payment.
One Master Order is created.
Separate Vendor Sub-orders are created for each vendor.

Each vendor can only manage its own sub-order.

Partial cancellation, partial refund and vendor-specific fulfilment must be supported.

eGrocer Source Code

The developer must review the eGrocer source code before finalizing the development plan and quotation.

Please clearly explain:

What is already available
What needs customization
What needs new development
Any technical limitations
Any third-party or API dependencies

Design and Graphics

Complete UI and UX design, branding and required launch graphics are part of the project scope.

The client should not need to hire a separate graphic designer for normal project deliverables.

Any exclusions must be clearly stated in the proposal before the project is awarded.

Proposal Requirements

Please provide:

Fixed total project price
Estimated completion time
Milestone breakdown
Recommended technology and architecture
Relevant multi-vendor marketplace experience
Stripe Connect experience
Portfolio or previous marketplace projects
Warranty and post-launch support
Maintenance cost
Third-party or API costs
Any exclusions or assumptions

Please do not submit a generic proposal.

Please review the attached document:

Native Sell - Detailed Developer Requirements and Scope of Work

before submitting your proposal.

I am looking for a long-term technical development partner, not simply someone to install a marketplace theme.

Freelancer Project: Shopify, Airtable & Marketplace Integration
Project Overview
We want to start with a small, clearly defined project and then expand it as we improve the system together.

The overall client goal is to create a reliable Airtable → Shopify listing system, then use ExportYourStore (EYS) to synchronize Shopify listings to multiple marketplaces.
Phase 1 — Airtable → Shopify API Integration

Compensation
- $15 base payment for the initial project
- $10 completion bonus when Phase 1 is working as specified
- $5/week for the next 5 weeks for adjustments, improvements, bug fixes, and collaboration as we improve the system - possibly ongoing

Objective
Build a Shopify API integration that takes complete product/listing information from Airtable and creates or updates listings in Shopify.
Build parallel [login to view URL] to do the same.

Requirements
1. DooDah Company Python Site 
 - Build and host the integration on a Python-based site for DooDah Company.
 - The system should be accessible for future development and improvements.
2. Open Code / Collaboration
 - Code must be available for inspection.
 - We want to be able to review, modify, and collaborate on the code.
 - No proprietary black-box system that prevents us from maintaining or improving it.

3. Initial Scale
- test 15 then sunc batches of 50
 - Approximately 800 listings
 - Approximately 900 products
 - The system should be designed so we can expand beyond this volume.

4. "List It" Button
 - Airtable should have a "List It" function/button.
 - When selected, the system should take the appropriate product information from Airtable and send it to Shopify through the Shopify API.
 - The system should create the Shopify listing/product and return the Shopify reference information to Airtable.

5. Shopify Reference Number
 - After a product is successfully listed, the Shopify reference number/ID should be written back into Airtable.
 - This will allow Airtable to know exactly which Shopify product corresponds to each Airtable product.

6. Inventory Synchronization
 - Inventory on hand needs to remain accurately aligned between Airtable and Shopify.
 - We need to avoid duplicate products and incorrect inventory counts.
 - The system should recognize existing Shopify products rather than creating duplicates.

7. Full Listing Information
 The integration should support the relevant Shopify listing information, including as applicable: 
 - Product title
 - Description
 - SKU
 - Price
 - Inventory
 - Images
 - Product type
 - Vendor/brand
 - Tags
 - Collections/categories
 - Other required Shopify product fields

8. Resync / Updating
 - Airtable will continue to be improved and corrected.
 - We need the ability to resync/update Shopify from Airtable as information changes.
 - The system should update the existing Shopify listing rather than creating a second listing.

Phase 1 Completion
Phase 1 will be considered complete when we can successfully:

Airtable → "List It" → Python/Shopify API → Shopify listing → Shopify reference returned to Airtable → inventory aligned → subsequent Airtable changes can be resynchronized to Shopify.

Phase 2 — Shopify → Multiple Marketplaces Through ExportYourStore
Compensation
- $10 base payment
- $10 completion bonus when the synchronization is successfully working

Objective
Once Phase 1 is working properly, we will use ExportYourStore (EYS) to synchronize Shopify listings to multiple marketplaces.

The target marketplaces are:
- eBay — 2 stores
- Vinted
- Mercari
- Poshmark
- Whatnot
- TikTok Shop
- Meta
-Google
-Amazon
We already know how to use ExportYourStore, so the primary objective is proper data alignment and mapping, not reinventing the EYS system.

Phase 2 Requirements
1. Shopify as the Source 
 - Shopify should contain the properly structured product/listing information coming from Phase 1.

2. ExportYourStore Mapping
 - Configure ExportYourStore so Shopify listings map correctly to the two eBay stores.
 - Ensure the appropriate fields are mapped accurately.

3. Marketplace Expansion 
 - Once Shopify → eBay is properly mapped, use EYS to map the same Shopify data to:
 - Vinted
 - Mercari
 - Poshmark
 - Whatnot
 - TikTok Shop

4. Data Alignment all specifications to achieve 100% in ebay downstream listings
 - Pay particular attention to:
 - SKU
 - Product title
 - Description
 - Images
 - Price
 - Quantity
 - Brand
 - Categories
 - Variations
 - Item specifics/attributes
 - Marketplace-specific fields

5. Inventory Accuracy 
 - Shopify should remain properly aligned with the marketplace listings.
 - We want to minimize overselling and duplicate inventory.

6. Testing
 - Test the complete process with actual products before considering the phase complete.
 - Verify that changes made upstream are properly reflected downstream.

That project will be scoped and priced separately once we determine exactly what needs to be integrated.

Overall Approach
The priority is not simply getting something working once. We want to build a system that is:
- Reliable
- Understandable
- Open for inspection
- Easy to modify
- Properly documented
- Scalable
- Accurate with inventory
- Easy for us to continue improving

If Phase 1 works well, we can continue working together on additional development and marketplace integrations.

full_description:
Freelance Social Media Designer — 12 Instagram Posts for Merged Insight

Project Type: One-Time Freelance Project
Deliverables: 12 Instagram Graphics + Captions + Hashtags
Brand: Merged Insight
Platform: Instagram

About Merged Insight

Merged Insight is a digital publication exploring culture, society, technology, psychology, media, lifestyle, and human behavior. Our focus is on thoughtful, visually compelling content that helps audiences understand the forces shaping modern life.

Our brand philosophy is simple: Insight That Matters.

Project Overview

We’re looking for a talented social media graphic designer/content creator to develop a package of 12 high-quality Instagram posts for Merged Insight.

The goal is to create a consistent, sophisticated Instagram presence that feels like a modern editorial publication rather than a traditional corporate social media account.

Think minimalist editorial design, strong typography, compelling ideas, and scroll-stopping visuals.

Deliverables

The freelancer will create 12 complete Instagram posts, with each post including:

- Original Instagram graphic/design
- Short in-graphic headline or statement
- Engaging Instagram caption
- Relevant hashtags
- Consistent Merged Insight branding
- Instagram-ready high-resolution files
- Editable source files

Creative Direction

The 12 posts should cover a mix of Merged Insight themes, including:

Culture & Society — observations about changing culture, social behavior, and modern life.

Technology & AI — thoughtful perspectives on artificial intelligence, algorithms, social media, and our relationship with technology.

Psychology & Human Behavior — attention, motivation, relationships, identity, habits, and how people think.

Media & Entertainment — commentary on film, music, digital culture, entertainment, and the attention economy.

Lifestyle & Perspective — meaningful, relatable ideas about creativity, ambition, slowing down, curiosity, and living intentionally.

Merged Insight Brand Posts — graphics that reinforce our identity, including phrases such as “Insight That Matters” and “Insight Over Noise.”

Caption Style

Captions should expand on the graphic rather than simply repeat its text.

For example:

Graphic:
“Your attention is being competed for.”

Caption:
Every notification, recommendation, headline, and endless scroll is competing for one of your most valuable resources: attention.

The question isn't simply how much time we spend online. It's how much of our thinking is being shaped while we're there.

At Merged Insight, we examine the technology, culture, and behaviors influencing modern life — because understanding what has your attention is the first step toward deciding what deserves it.

Hashtags:
#MergedInsight #InsightThatMatters #DigitalCulture #Technology #HumanBehavior #ModernLife #SocialMedia #Culture #Psychology

Visual Style

We are looking for a clean, premium, editorial aesthetic.

The Merged Insight visual identity should primarily use black and white, strong typography, intentional negative space, and minimalist layouts. Designs should feel intelligent and contemporary without becoming overly corporate.

References can include the visual language of modern magazines, independent publications, editorial websites, and premium media brands.

What We're Looking For

The ideal freelancer has experience with social media design, particularly Instagram and editorial-style content. Strong typography, layout, branding, and visual storytelling skills are important.

You should also be comfortable turning larger ideas into simple, memorable social content.

Please avoid: generic Canva-template aesthetics, cluttered graphics, excessive stock imagery, overly colorful designs, AI-looking imagery without purpose, and engagement-bait content.

Application Requirements

When applying, please include:

- A short introduction
- Relevant Instagram/social media design samples
- Editorial or publication work, if available
- Your price for the complete 12-post package
- Estimated turnaround time
- Software used for design
- Confirmation that editable source files will be included

Final Deliverables

The completed project should include 12 finished Instagram graphics, 12 original captions, hashtag sets for all 12 posts, and editable design/source files.

There is potential for ongoing monthly work if the initial project is a strong fit.

Merged Insight
Insight That Matters.
